_comment: Workload profiles (Part III Section 4.3.3.2, Part IV 5.2.4.1). Only resolution and inference rate change; model and threads are fixed. rate_hz null = back-to-back. reduced_load has NO rate yet: it must be measured on the Pi 5 with 'edge_workload.py calibrate --fraction F --write', where F is the team's agreed fraction of balanced FPS. The workload refuses to run reduced_load until then.
